title: Spicy Sujebi Noodle Soup
description: A traditional Korean noodle soup dish made with a spicy broth and sujebi (hand-pulled noodles). This recipe is a hearty and comforting meal for any time of the year.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the Korean chili flakes, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the pot.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the sujebi noodles to the pot and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
Stir in the Korean chili paste and green onions.
Serve the noodles in bowls and garnish with additional green onions if desired.
Serve with udon noodles on the side, if desired.
